WITH paper AS (SELECT id FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%'),
live AS (SELECT f.id FROM fills f JOIN live_orders o ON o.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id
AND o.id=(SELECT min(x.id) FROM live_orders x WHERE x.kalshi_order_id=f.kalshi_order_id)
WHERE o.strategy ILIKE '%mmsell%')
SELECT 'bot_readonly_elevated' AS metric,(rolsuper OR rolcreatedb OR rolcreaterole OR rolreplication OR rolbypassrls)::text AS value FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname='bot_readonly'
UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_readonly_memberships',count(*)::text FROM pg_auth_members m JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=m.member WHERE r.rolname='bot_readonly'
UNION ALL SELECT 'bot_readonly_direct_nonselect_grants',count(*)::text FROM information_schema.role_table_grants WHERE grantee='bot_readonly' AND privilege_type<>'SELECT'
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_ids_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(id::text,',' ORDER BY id),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM paper
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_ids_sha256',encode(sha256(convert_to(coalesce(string_agg(id::text,',' ORDER BY id),''),'UTF8')),'hex') FROM live
